name: Youth Career Services (WIOA)
org: Santa Barbara County Workforce Development Board, with Goodwill Industries Youth Centers
what_you_do: Get a paid job at a local business that fits what you like. A boss there coaches you. The program also helps with tutoring, college plans, money skills and leading others.
who_can_apply: You must be 14 to 24 and live in Santa Barbara County. You must be allowed to work in the US. You must need help to find a job or get into school.
pay_detail: Paid work experience. The page does not list a wage.
deadline_text: No deadline. Orientations are held every Tuesday from 4 to 5 p.m. on Zoom.
how_to_apply: Call a youth center to join a Tuesday Zoom meeting. Santa Barbara: 805-845-3926. Santa Maria: 805-928-5282. Lompoc: 805-736-6700. You can also email workforceservices@goodwillvsb.org. The county page has a short form too.
notes: This is a federal WIOA program, so you have to qualify, and the youth center checks eligibility. Centers are open Monday to Thursday 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. and Friday 8 a.m. to noon. Santa Barbara center: 302 W Carrillo Street. Paid work under 18 in California needs a work permit.
